title: 7. vvhye it vvas neceſſarye that the firſte man shoulde be created good and pure.

segments.text: FOR to execute thys counſell • was neceſſarye that god ſhoulde create nan good and pure, for beſyde this that god himſelfe beinge good he can doe nothinge but that whiche is good, but if man had bene created wicked or euyll, god had not had iuſt occaſion to puniſhe the wickednes wherof h• himſelfe was the authour and maker.
